name: cloud-native-azure-functions
description: Use when the user asks about Azure Functions, Durable Functions orchestrator or activity functions, durable entities, fan-out/fan-in, Event Grid triggers, Flex Consumption or other hosting plans. Produces replay-safe Durable Functions code and a hosting-plan choice. Not for AWS Lambda (use cloud-native-aws-serverless) or Step Functions (use cloud-native-serverless-orchestration).
